subject: Resilience evidence catalogue and RTO/RPO clarifications
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@harborbank.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: HarborBank Security <compliance@harborbank.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Nov 2025 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Initial ask: RTO/RPO evidence catalogue and witness availability

Hi Camila,

Thanks for taking the call earlier. As discussed, HarborBank's compliance team needs a short catalogue of artifacts for our operational resilience review. Our immediate priorities are:

- RTO and RPO attestation artifacts (recent test results and timestamps)
- Evidence of KV-cache warm-up and prefix restore during failover
- A short list of personnel who can provide a 30–45 minute live witness/demo during a scheduled window

Can you provide a single index (spreadsheet or PDF) that maps each request to an artifact (file name, owner, brief description, and timestamp)? If you can include a few representative log extracts (no PII) that show failover timing that would be ideal.

We are aiming to complete the operational review the week of Dec 8; would you be available for a 30-minute witness session that week?

Thanks,
Liam

--
Liam O'Connor
Director, Security Assurance
HarborBank
liam.oconnor@harborbank.com

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@harborbank.com>
Cc: HarborBank Security <compliance@harborbank.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Nov 2025 10:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask: RTO/RPO evidence catalogue and witness availability

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear list. We're on it.

I've created a consolidated index (attached) that maps your items to artifacts we can share immediately. Summary notes:

- RTO/RPO attestation: see tab "RTO_RPO_Index" in the attached BCP-evidence-index-20251130.xlsx — includes test dates, measured RTO/RPO, and links to raw traces.
- KV-cache warm-up: we included representative warmup traces and a short description of the automated prefix caching logic.
- Witnesses: Ben Carter (Ops lead) and Priyom Das (SRE) are onboard for a live witness. Ben will lead the warmstart replay; Priyom will be available to walk through logs and answer architecture questions.

Action items for the Red team (internal):
- Priyom: attach RPO snapshot CSV and call out timestamps for the last three exercises.
- Ben: produce a short runbook excerpt and confirm a 30-45 min slot; also attach the tabletop invite (ics).
- Irene: please confirm that there are no privacy-sensitive fields in the attached traces before we send to HarborBank's compliance distribution.

Liam — attached is our index and a few artifact stubs. We can follow up with the raw CSV and log extracts in a second message (we want to sanitize traces first). Proposed witness windows: Dec 8 10:00–11:00 PT or Dec 10 14:00–15:00 PT. Which works better for your team?

Regards,

--
Camila Reyes
Manager, Customer Security
Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com
Attachments: BCP-evidence-index-20251130.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@harborbank.com>, HarborBank Security <compliance@harborbank.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Nov 2025 11:24:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask: RTO/RPO evidence catalogue and witness availability

Camila / team — attaching the sanitized extracts we agreed on. Key notes inline below.

Attachments: rpo-snapshots-2025-11-01_to_2025-11-28.csv; kv-cache-warmup-traces-20251115.log

- rpo-snapshots CSV: contains per-region RPO observations for the November run. Columns: run_id, region, requested_rpo_secs, observed_rpo_secs, start_ts, end_ts. No customer data included.
- kv-cache-warmup-traces: trimmed log window (5 minutes) around the warmstart event from 2025-11-15. I removed instance IDs that map to internal ticketing numbers, per Irene's guidance.

Observed highlights from the November run:
- Average observed_rpo_secs across warm-restart exercises: 62s (requested RPO = 120s)
- KV warmup median time to first cache hit: 18s after prefix restore

Irene — flagged the log sections that still include internal debug tokens (marked with XXX) — can you confirm redaction ok?

Ben — I can run the replay for the witness session in the staging region and expose a read-only dashboard for telemetry.

—Priyom

--
Priyom Das
SRE, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwoodinference.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@harborbank.com>, HarborBank Security <compliance@harborbank.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Dec 2025 09:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask: RTO/RPO evidence catalogue and witness availability

Camila / Liam —

Thanks — I can run the live witness/demo for either slot. Prefer Dec 8 10:00 PT. Plan for the session: 30-minute runbook walkthrough (15m) + 15-minute Q&A. I will:

- Start with a short overview of the reported RTO/RPO metrics and where they map in the spreadsheet.
- Execute a staged warmstart in our staging cluster (no customer traffic) and highlight the KV warmup timeline.
- Bring up the read-only Grafana dashboard showing token-level latency and cache hit rate.

Irene — can you confirm the final redaction review? If clean, I'll send the calendar invite (tabletop-witness-invite.ics).

Liam — if Dec 8 10:00 PT works, I'll send the invite and include a short pre-read (2 pages) with the key measures.

Ben

--
Ben Carter
Lead, Site Reliability
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Attachments: tabletop-witness-invite.ics (calendar invite)

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@harborbank.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: HarborBank Security <compliance@harborbank.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Dec 2025 15:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask: RTO/RPO evidence catalogue and witness availability

Camila / Ben / Priyom —

Dec 8 10:00 PT works for HarborBank. Appreciate the quick turnaround and the sanitized extracts. A couple of follow-ups before the session:

1) Can you add a one-line justification in the index for each artifact describing why it satisfies SOC 2 CC/BCP evidence expectations? (e.g., "RPO snapshot — shows measured recovery windows from automated DR exercises; maps to CC7.1/CC7.2")
2) Please confirm whether the Grafana dashboard contains any token or user identifiers; if so, we need read-only views with masking.

If you can add the one-line justification for each row in the spreadsheet and confirm the dashboard masking by EOD Dec 4, we'll be set for the Dec 8 witness.

Thanks, and see you then.

Best,
Liam

--
Liam O'Connor
Director, Security Assurance
HarborBank
liam.oconnor@harborbank.com
